title: [Bug]: WSL2: RuntimeError: UVA is not available on RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (vLLM 0.24.0, CUDA 13.0)
author: grvwrk

comments.author: SmartAI
comments.body:
Traced this. On WSL2, `is_pin_memory_available()` returns `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY`, which defaults to 0 (`vllm/platforms/cuda.py`, made opt-in in #41496 because pinned memory has overhead on small tensors under WSL2). That makes `is_uva_available()` false — and the V2 model runner, now the default, hard-requires UVA buffers at init (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/buffer_utils.py:47`, exactly your traceback). Same root cause as #47292.

Runner selection already falls back to V1 when Triton is missing, so I'll open a PR doing the same when UVA isn't available, plus a clearer error when V2 is explicitly forced.

In the meantime `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1` should let you keep the V2 runner — could you check whether that works on your setup?

comments.author: elaugaste
comments.body:
> In the meantime `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1` should let you keep the V2 runner — could you check whether that works on your setup?

I had the same problem. I checked, VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 allows using the V2 model runner (v0.24) with WSL2.  Thanks
